blocks.markdown: Updated 13 November 2026. WIP15 remains the latest published and remotely verified checkpoint. Bounded shared/flat/PER replay repair A is published; recurrent replay B1/B3/B4 now has approved local source and CPU evidence at R84. The owner caller/fixture gate, full parent/runner and programme acceptance remain open.

BAC has **28 qualified releases out of the original 66 packages**, with **38 original packages still requiring qualification**. WIP15 publishes independently reviewed replay repair A and its exact source/process/child evidence. This is bounded component delivery, not a package closure or whole-BAC release.
# Current position

| Area | Status | What this means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Original package releases | 28 qualified, 38 remaining | All 66 canonical package IDs remain unchanged; final acceptance on one common source revision is still owed. |
| Later component delivery | Bounded BANK/owner CPU component qualified | Managed RNG admission occurs before the BANK lock; authentic lineage reaches private/shared operations. Native state and gradients are captured together, saved native configuration is reconstructed offside, required owners stay alive through publication, and final currency plus uncertain-completion checks fail closed. See the [BANK contract](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/678513c7540a61114d59a17d1b1e0eb8a06ce0a2/docs/remediation/bac/CURRENT-CURIOSITY-BANK-CONTRACT.md), [checkpoint contract](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/678513c7540a61114d59a17d1b1e0eb8a06ce0a2/docs/remediation/bac/CURRENT-CURIOSITY-CHECKPOINT-CONTRACT.md) and [RNG core contract](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/678513c7540a61114d59a17d1b1e0eb8a06ce0a2/docs/remediation/bac/CURRENT-RNG-CUSTODY-CORE-CONTRACT.md). |
| Current work | Owner caller/fixture repair active; recurrent B boundedly approved locally | R82 retained 12 genuine mutable-DTO RED cases and two fixture-prerequisite failures. R83's 24 selected passes established corrected prerequisites, not full fixed-production GREEN. R84 source/specification/quality/API review approves recurrent B1/B3/B4: root replay selections pass 109 unique cases (old54 + recurrent55); independent recurrent55 overlaps the root selection and is not added. Actual child/source/spec/result/PID/PPID/import/thread custody passed. The 49-case owner gate stopped at one pass and one missing-lineage failure, leaving 47 unexecuted. Its test-only current-caller/fixture repair is active; no result yet. |
| Published checkpoint | [WIP15 29d0204a](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/commit/29d0204a70b6eef0017b3cee638812e2cc5c7899) | Remote SHA 29d0204a70b6eef0017b3cee638812e2cc5c7899, publication tree f71ae2bdee57ebf7e5949f02e40cbc1b91a4c83d, parent 678513c7540a61114d59a17d1b1e0eb8a06ce0a2; verified by GitHub ref/commit and actual git ls-remote. Existing branch pushed successfully. [WIP15 evidence](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/29d0204a70b6eef0017b3cee638812e2cc5c7899/docs/remediation/bac/evidence/wave35-wip-15.json) binds executed R81 candidate 4bcb26ec56bc2664949baab7d6b14e3c1da76b01; publication and execution identities remain distinct. Latest observed [Config PASS](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/actions/runs/43406791037); [Lint FAIL](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/actions/runs/43406791002/job/131822957153): Ruff passed, but Black would reformat only src/townlet/training/sequential_replay_buffer.py (one file; 718 unchanged). Mypy and defaults were SKIPPED, not passed. [Tests](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/actions/runs/43406791198) remain IN_PROGRESS at the latest 2026-11-13 10:50:46 UTC observation; no green CI claim. Historical WIP14 CI: Config PASS, Lint FAIL with six oracle errors, Tests FAIL with cause/counts unknown because raw logs were inaccessible. |
| Evidence and review | Repair A source, execution and evidence-chain reviews passed within scope | [Current replay custody contract](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/29d0204a70b6eef0017b3cee638812e2cc5c7899/docs/remediation/bac/CURRENT-REPLAY-CUSTODY-CONTRACT.md) records the bounded behavior. R81 root and independent runs each pass the same 54 cases; actual child PID/PPID, parent Process PID, spec/result and source identities are paired. The R73–R81 publication preserves failed and UNRUN attempts without overlap inflation. Prior WIP14 evidence remains historical: coherent 1,290 passes/two unavailable-CUDA skips, overlapping independent 155 BANK cases, 34 CLI packs/35 processes and 13 coherent/four independent children. |
| Overall BAC acceptance | Whole-owner, integration and final repository gates remain open | R84 global Ruff, global Black, defaults, owned-four mypy and all-three public result-type checks pass; this fixes the prior recurrent formatting/defaults sites without rewriting historical failures. No new global-mypy run is claimed. Owner49 intended assertions, CUDA B6/core/device capability, caller/BANK/runtime/ENV/native integration and full current-parent restoration remain required, alongside full repository/coverage, slow/hardware, learning, final 54 requirements/22 lenses and exact-final-remote green CI. |

The accepted conversion component supports explicit fresh-private initialization and cloning learned state while preserving the complete source archive as inactive history. Native inherited counters and future per-world counters remain distinct, with explicit origin and epoch provenance. Ordered native dictionaries and Torch metadata survive owned transport. The native metadata repair passed 16 cases in both root and independent Astra runs; the repaired existing owner suite passed 31 cases in each run, with one CUDA skip each. The earlier combined 973-pass result included the none-scale repair; that earlier coherent component suite had 1,123 passes and three CUDA skips. These selections overlap and must not be added together. These results qualify the bounded component; actual population, runner, native-parent admission and captured-replay sampling and learning remain open.
# Work completed
The 28 qualified original releases cover these delivered areas:

| Delivered behavior | Qualified package IDs |
| --- | --- |
| Finite authored numerics, portable options, exploration resolution, effective identity, historical archive and fresh-buffer import, lossless sidecar lowering, canonical launch and CLI transport, canonical discovery | T01, T02, T18a, T03, T03a, T04, T05, T06, T07 |
| Legal action selection and successor masks, completed-lane action gating, uniform and prioritized replay, real short windows, matching PER estimators, recurrent PER, production collection and learner readiness | T08, T08a, T09, T09a, T10, T11, T12, T13, T14, T15 |
| Effective runner warmup, descriptor/value interactions, bounded RND service and tails, count novelty, ICM, completion envelopes and clock ledger | T16, T17, T18, T18b, T18c, T19 |
| Explicit curiosity scope and seeds, private RNG foundations, recording work that survives shutdown | PW01, PW02, T33 |
Later accepted component work is tracked separately:

- **Curriculum and world foundations:** completion-driven curriculum and option/factory producers, compiled roster and identity/state maintenance, and world-state owner components. Their actual joint runtime routing remains open.

- **Provider construction and service:** typed events and local clocks, RNG binding, the five-provider factory and separate policy selector; RND, ICM and adaptive providers perform real updates using their declared local service and native-state contracts.

- **Private curiosity bank:** independently owned state for all five provider families, local replay and service, completion publication and failure custody. The explicit shared alternative retains grouped behavior. The bounded bank passed 84 root and 84 independent cases, with 551 covering passes and three CUDA skips.

- **Same-scope checkpoint component:** off-side validation and preparation of models, gradients, optimizer, RNG, clocks, phases, caches and history; strict identity checks, owned installation and current replay-component preservation. It passed 147 root and 147 independent cases, with 635 covering passes and three CUDA skips. These overlapping selections are not added together.

These bank and checkpoint results use bounded component fixtures. They do not prove complete DQN/runner parent admission, captured replay sampling or ordinary end-to-end resume. The [published qualification evidence](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/30a802a996fe8bf7cd63e53d211fa8b2cd028f77/docs/remediation/bac/evidence/wave34-wip-01.json) and [runtime contract](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/30a802a996fe8bf7cd63e53d211fa8b2cd028f77/docs/remediation/bac/CURRENT-EXPLORATION-RUNTIME-CONTRACT.md) record the reviewed runtime component and current curriculum consumer repair. The runtime component passed 150 independent tests and a coherent 1,123-pass selection with three CUDA skips, plus independent source/specification and documentation truth review. The repair uses the real completed-event API, with no compatibility-only adapter: 52 migrated cases and 175 event regressions passed, for 227 passes. Compiler CLI validation also passed for 34 packs across 35 processes with verified source, import and thread identities. The subsequent full-repository run at the exact pushed source failed after 2,003.7499 seconds. Verification covered 797 source files, 573 configurations, 13 artifacts, all five pytest processes, the index and registry custody; the separately verified poisoning child also passed its assertions. Failure triage identifies 1,241 deduplicated failed test-node/phase records across 160 affected source files and 15 terminal-signature groups, chiefly missing world-identity constructor inputs, required reservation/activation, old curriculum/provider calls and stale option/schema assertions. These records are not 1,241 independent algorithmic defects. Repair causal prerequisites until tests reach their intended assertions before another broad run. The failed baseline and triage are now published in the [earlier checkpoint evidence](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/31beef58892fe651daf6c9965f372b3643523ce2/docs/remediation/bac/evidence/wave35-wip-01.json). The [intrinsic-scale composer contract](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/31beef58892fe651daf6c9965f372b3643523ce2/docs/remediation/bac/CURRENT-INTRINSIC-SCALE-COMPOSER-CONTRACT.md) records the new bounded math/API component: raw reward 2 × scale 0.5 × weight 0.25 × modifier 2 produces intrinsic reward 0.5 and total reward 1.6 in the tested case. At that earlier checkpoint, compiler CLI validation passed for 34 packs across 35 processes in 171.4223 seconds, with 798-source, import and thread identity verification. Four cheap guards pass. These checks do not establish current full-repository or all-family end-to-end qualification. The [new published evidence](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/1938f7cac6dca6ecb31952c9f31cc74248024dd0/docs/remediation/bac/evidence/wave35-wip-02.json) and [canonical reward-flow contract](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/1938f7cac6dca6ecb31952c9f31cc74248024dd0/docs/remediation/bac/CURRENT-CANONICAL-REWARD-FLOW-CONTRACT.md) now record actual environment-to-parent delivery. The same 75 cases passed independently with no errors, skips or warnings: all five families and both scopes, phase and identity transport, canonical replay, pre-physics claim, real active-effect and pending-cancellation cases, retirement, and the original single-batch commitment/reset failure controls. Actual raw reward 2 × scale 0.5 × weight 0.25 × modifier 2 produced intrinsic reward 0.5 and total 1.6. A late runtime/callback rebinding defect was found and repaired; nine binding cases pass. Current compiler CLI validation passed 34 packs across 35 verified processes in 152.12084 seconds. These bounded results do not qualify complete native restore, genuine end-to-end learning or an integrated package release.
# Work remaining
Every one of the 38 original packages still awaiting qualification appears once below. Some contain accepted components; each still owes its full package behavior and integration evidence.

| Workstream and packages | Remaining deliverable and completion condition |
| --- | --- |
| Provider foundations — PW04, PW03, PW05, PW06 | Complete backend/native consumer coherence, factory and bank runtime use, and strict checkpoint integration. Pass the real ordinary runner checkpoint and full owner suites; component approval alone does not close these packages. |
| Explicit conversion — PW07 | Bounded fresh-private and learned-template conversion, current-owner checks and the combined component gate have passed independent review. Complete real native-parent and runner integration and full package qualification, preserving source archives, compatible state and truthful origin/counter semantics. |
| Runtime curiosity routing — T18d, T18e, PW08a, PW08, T18f | Complete population, runner and native-parent integration around the reviewed runtime and canonical environment reward flow. The primitive's 29-case proof, published 75-case environment/parent checkpoint and later 78-case selection are bounded evidence. Original commitment/reset findings and the additional exact multi-batch retry and prepare/install binding defects are repaired and independently approved within their tested limits. Native learning reset is implemented in the three model providers and independently source/API approved; its 61 cases pass within the now-published coherent 139-case run. Count/None native reset now has source and final contract truth approval, with 154 root and 154 overlapping independent passes published at d4426803. The shared/private RNG custody core is now boundedly qualified at 11ec9885. WIP14 now qualifies bounded CPU BANK/checkpoint adoption of domain-before-lock custody, authentic lineage, atomic native/gradient capture, saved-native restoration, owner lifetime and final currency. All five families and both scopes have restored-learning and equal-authentic-input BANK witnesses. Full native-parent correlation, enrolled direct consumers, joint publication and the ordinary runner remain open. The earlier _Run/VFS fixture checkpoint had 298 passes and four unqualified CUDA skips; the new core API requires current-owner requalification. Its world-only transport did not establish full native learner restore. The initial-participation environment producer now has 57 root and 57 overlapping independent passes at 7a96f86d. The additional read-only environment participation validator is now implemented and reviewed at 00889036, with 80 root and 80 overlapping independent passes; active validation remains unchanged. The population consumer, private pre-Q seal and owned public-query checks are now implemented and reviewed at d152425f. Its bounded proof includes active-world learning/replay, inactive-world privacy, mixed closure and the next cycle. Broader mixed-participation coverage, stable role-owner completed restore, native transfer/reset and history/cache/clock correlation remain required. Complete broader environment and lifecycle witnesses, captured-replay learning and ordinary checkpoint smoke before package qualification. |
| Curriculum integration — T20, T21, T22, T23 | Integrate accepted curriculum producers and provenance, implement per-world dynamics, and prove each world's completion and controller decisions reach its own mechanics through population and runner. |
| Checkpoint and restart — T24, PW09, T25, T26 | Finish boundary/schema and selection, scope/binding dispatch, full predictor/replay/clock restoration and one episode-end transaction. Prove atomic refusal, captured replay preservation and usable sampling/readiness, plus durable intent/effect reentry. |
| Transfer and serving — T27, T28, T29, T30, PW10, T31, T32 | Deliver explicit evaluation modes and reset, truthful partial and strict transfer, effective artifact identity, schema-aware target-state policy, explicit private source-world selection, process-isolated serving, and a current all-family evaluator. |
| Outputs and diagnostics — T34, T35, T36, PW11 | Own recorder failures during runner cleanup; preserve sink units and outcomes, effective hyperparameters and intervention reporting, and per-world scope, origin and scale diagnostics. A scalar summary must never replace per-world reward scales. |
| Isolation and lifecycle proof — PW12, PW13, PW14, PW15 | Inventory actual simulator state owners; prove private rewards and state across real curiosity updates, reset/resume/conversion and archived history; verify each controller lane and the declared shared-Q feedback boundary. |
| Joint acceptance and learning — T37, T38, T39, PW16, T40 | Complete learning-support, restart/transfer/serve/discovery and persisted-output matrices; prove truthful shared/private support and run the finite original learning protocol plus the strict cohort after integrity gates pass. |
# Next delivery steps

1. Complete the active test-only owner caller/fixture repair, preserving mandatory explicit lineage, then run its intended assertions and obtain scoped review. R84's 49-case owner selection stopped at one pass and one missing-lineage failure; 47 cases were not executed, and the active repair has no result yet. Recurrent B1/B3/B4 now has bounded source/API and CPU evidence approval. Complete full current-parent Q/replay/network/optimizer/scheduler/curriculum restoration and joint all-child publication/failure handling; preserve genuine sampling/readiness and learning, current authority and owner lifetime.

2. Repair and qualify the required ordinary runner/oracle integration, direct-consumer enrollment, stable-role/full-D behavior and T26 durability. The known ordinary-runner case was excluded only from R72's bounded selection and remains required. Preserve saved native/optimizer/gradient configuration, SOURCE archive/TARGET initialization semantics, bare-Adam/manual-replacement/signed-offset support and alias-quiescence boundaries. C10/K01 do not require independent exact simulator trajectory continuation.

3. Resolve the remaining six oracle-driver type errors through genuine current owner/caller contracts, preserving scripted RNG/mechanics and pinned-reference capability. WIP14's remote mypy log confirms the fourteen BANK-lineage errors are gone; it still fails on oracle constructor world_roster/training_seed/lane_world_ids, reset reservation, step vector_step and Tensor/WorldRecord assignment. Complete full/default, coverage, slow, applicable hardware, learning, final 54-requirement/22-lens review and exact-final-remote CI; do not infer final acceptance from bounded passes.
4. Finish curriculum, checkpoint/restart, transfer/serving and diagnostics packages in dependency order, followed by the complete isolation and joint acceptance evidence.
# Final completion criteria

- All **54 effective requirements**, **22 fresh final design and implementation review lenses**, and independent synthesis pass on the final common immutable source, with no unresolved P1/P2 findings or unapproved in-scope gaps.

- Real runtime evidence covers all four Q families, all five curiosity providers and both scopes through compilation, rollout, updates, save/load and serving. Private isolation uses real local learning and complete named state owners, including lifecycle and controlled shared-Q cases.

- The original T40 learning protocol is retained. The additional strict cohort is exactly **12 runs**: four families × seeds 11, 29 and 47, each with 10,000 eligible training transitions and 20 evaluation episodes per seed, using explicit per-world adaptive RND and actual local predictor updates. Record controls, metrics, failures and deviations; do not infer a causal shared/private comparison from differing settings.

- Required default full-repository, coverage of at least 70%, slow, applicable hardware, static and exact-final-remote CI checks pass. Source-verified documentation and supported end-to-end scenarios agree with the actual behavior.

The [accepted per-world requirements](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/a7c4cd0b19c410114aaabdd9284888fef159e84e/docs/remediation/bac/PER-WORLD-CURIOSITY-ADDENDUM.md) define the finite isolation and learning obligations. Current tracking reflects later accepted amendments, including the 54-requirement and 22-lens totals.
# Decisions and boundaries

**No user decision blocks current CPU integration work.** The promised 16-worker CUDA server is not yet available or verified; CUDA and the hardware skips remain unqualified. Astra's additive CUDA design (initial 97755650; fix1 c8a899fd) passed scoped independent design review 1ad148e4; implementation and hardware execution remain unrun. Before admission, implement and qualify the reviewed design and additive capture/harness versions with portable resource measurement, explicit GPU profiles, bounded job/device concurrency and immutable process/receipt custody. Preserve historical hashed helpers and attempts. Hardware availability alone closes no gate. Strict per-world curiosity is required, with the explicit shared alternative preserved; omitted scope retains shared behavior. Shared Q and policy feedback remain permitted under the declared controlled-trace isolation guarantee.

Current producers, callers, tests and documentation evolve together without legacy adapters or compatibility loaders. Preserve historical artifacts, backups, source archives and current captured replay. C10/K01's simulator-continuation deferral remains explicit. The [current evidence index](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/29d0204a70b6eef0017b3cee638812e2cc5c7899/docs/remediation/bac/EVIDENCE-INDEX.md), [WIP15 manifest](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/29d0204a70b6eef0017b3cee638812e2cc5c7899/docs/remediation/bac/evidence/wave35-wip-15.json) and [evidence process](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/29d0204a70b6eef0017b3cee638812e2cc5c7899/docs/remediation/bac/EVIDENCE-PROCESS.md) publish the finite R73–R81 interval: 68 checks, 54 completed commands (35 passed, 19 failed) and 14 UNRUN specs. Command totals are not unique test counts. Publication retains 404 objects: 394 new / 7,157,529 bytes and 10 reused, with 638 logical aliases. Exact candidate source deltas preserve intermediate source provenance from the durable WIP14 base; failures, unrun templates, historical report-prefix recovery and overlapping attempts remain explicit. Manifest SHA-256 fe3d07654f97441e88135c1c8c68a370e223fff1625178d2f38cffe2c9453890; selection plan 8e3c5de089fdd68688b9dbd69133b0d05186294312acfbb398301ee42ecf6e15. Terminal v3 received independent approvals 2c421d53 and 7053dd42; final receipt ccd491be. The sealed historical WIP14 publication remains unchanged. Evidence-chain publication improves durability and traceability; it does not close outstanding package or programme gates. The next unpublished interval starts at R82: retain R82 genuine RED and prerequisite failures, R83 fixture correction and selected CPU child, and R84 bounded recurrent approval plus the failed owner gate. A future owner-repair receipt and explicit terminal subject/review are still owed; WIP16 is not sealed or published.
This is a private tracking Page. Its repository links remain subject to the viewer's GitHub access. It records the stated snapshot and is not configured for automatic updates.
